messages:
Maya Patel: heads up — seeing a surge of 401s across multiple customers in eu-west1 starting ~08:12UTC. root cause unclear, looks tied to auth-proxy. logs show 503s then downstream 401s. raising incident. :rotating_light:
Jordan Lee: on it. any recent deploys or config changes to auth-proxy or key-sync around 08:00?
Samir Khatri: I kicked off a key-rotation job at 07:58 but it reported success. pulling a repro now. can you paste one failing request id?
SupportAgent: customer "BrightFlow" reported their API calls started failing at 08:15. example trace id: trace-0x9a7b. They see 401s in client logs.
Maya Patel: attaching quick curl from customer (redacted):

Samir Khatri: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer XXXXXX" -H "X-Request-ID: trace-0x9a7b" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< {"error":"invalid_token","message":"token not found in keystore","code":401}
```

Eve Chen: OpsBot alert: `auth-proxy error-rate > 5% (5m)` triggered at 08:13:22. linking metrics: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/auth-proxy-errors (internal) :eyes: 
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-8449 (priority P1)
Jordan Lee: Samir, can you check jwks/key-sync logs and S3 access for jwks bucket? last rotation touched the ingestion path.
Samir Khatri: grabbing logs from key-sync. found repeated errors: `permission denied` when fetching jwks for project cluster-eu-west1. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T07:58:34Z key-sync ERROR fetch_jwks: GET https://s3-eu.example/jwks/project-eu-west1: 403 Forbidden
2026-03-15T07:58:35Z key-sync ERROR retry: max_retries_exhausted
```

Jordan Lee: 403 fetching jwks would cause keystore to be stale -> tokens minted with new keys won't validate. that matches invalid_token message. who changed S3 ACLs?
Maya Patel: OpsSecurity ticket shows an automated policy cleanup rolled back a read policy on the jwks bucket at 07:50 for compliance. looks like key-rotation started after that.
SupportAgent: customer impact: BrightFlow (prod) and NovaRetail (staging) both affected. Support template drafted: "We are aware of authentication failures affecting API calls in eu-west1. We are rolling back key sync and applying fallback keys while we fix the JWKS access. We will follow up with timeline and remediation."
Samir Khatri: mitigation plan: 1) enable `KEYSTORE_FALLBACK=true` on auth-proxy to allow primary keystore (old keys) to validate for 5m 2) re-run key-sync after restoring S3 read perms 3) run canary token validation. executing step 1 now.
DeployBot: deploy triggered by Samir: set-env auth-proxy KEYSTORE_FALLBACK=true --env=eu-west1
DeployBot: deploy finished: success in 18s (revision r-2026-344)

Samir Khatri: fallback enabled. monitoring.
Eve Chen: error rate dropping in grafana now — from 6.2% to 0.9% in ~70s. link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/auth-proxy-errors
Jordan Lee: can you confirm client 401s are resolved for BrightFlow?
SupportAgent: BrightFlow confirms API is working again. NovaRetail still showing intermittent failures but trending down. :thumbsup:
Samir Khatri: restored S3 read ACLs for jwks bucket at 08:23 and re-ran key-sync. logs show success:
```
2026-03-15T08:24:01Z key-sync INFO fetch_jwks: GET https://s3-eu.example/jwks/project-eu-west1: 200 OK
2026-03-15T08:24:02Z key-sync INFO keystore_update: applied 3 keys (added 1, rotated 2)
```

Maya Patel: root cause summary: compliance policy cleanup inadvertently removed read permission on JWKS storage just before scheduled key rotation. rotation job failed to fetch keys and left keystore out-of-sync, causing newly issued tokens to be unrecognized -> 401s.
Jordan Lee: immediate remediation done (fallback + restore ACL + re-sync). impact window ~08:12-08:24 UTC. all customers report recovery.
Samir Khatri: next steps (action items):
- add pre-rotation canary: after a rotation job finishes, run a quick validation against a canary token (on-call + eng-ml runbook)
- modify key-sync to retry with exponential backoff and post-failure alert to avoid silent keystore drift
- prevent automated policy cleanups from removing jwks read perms; add IAM exception
- update runbook with `KEYSTORE_FALLBACK` and how to toggle via console + CLI

Eve Chen: I'll file a postmortem and schedule a follow-up triage 09:30 UTC. assigning owners: Samir (engineer), Maya (incident lead), Jordan (postmortem reviewer), SupportAgent (customer comms).
SupportAgent: customer comm sent to affected accounts. template saved at https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/templates/auth-jwks-rotation.md
Jordan Lee: suggested low-effort alert improvement: add a sentinel metric for "keystore last-sync-success" and alert on >2min stale.
Maya Patel: agreed. also note we should add an automated safety: if key-sync fails X times, pause further rotations and notify security before proceeding.
Samir Khatri: logging note: made a small patch to key-sync to include `rotation_id` in logs to trace partial rotations (PR #2984).
DeployBot: PR #2984 deployed to staging.

Maya Patel: closing incident channel. please add any follow-ups to INC-2026-8449 in Jira. thanks all for quick response. :heart:
